messages:
Maria: Quick idea — holiday meme-off + kudos chain? Winner gets bragging rights and a mystery snack from the kitchen :sunglasses:
Devon: I'm so in. Rules?
Maria: Post one holiday meme in this thread, keep it PG-13. Vote by reacting :snowflake: for best meme. Also drop a one-line kudos to a teammate you appreciated this year.
Raj: Love it. Kicking off the kudos portion early — big thanks to @Maria for organizing the eng winter retro, that was super helpful :clap: (and cookies).
Sara: Ooh nice, I'll go after my meeting. Shoutout to @Raj for being the bug whisperer on Friday night.
Devon: Alright meme time. Meme: "When you finally get the model to stop hallucinating — you, sipping cocoa while it apologizes." (image: tiny holiday llama) :joy:
Maria: Haha perfect. Here's my meme: "Me writing one more unit test before the holidays" *picture of Santa with a laptop and 3 monitors* :santa:
Raj: Posting mine in 2 — fair warning it's a dad-tier pun.
OfficeBot: Reminder: Holiday snacks restocked at 3pm today. Please be courteous and label allergy-friendly items. :cookie:
Devon: Kudos to @Sara again — her docs made onboarding so much smoother for the new hire this month :raised_hands:
Sara: Thanks! Also nominating @Devon for Best On-Call Calm — the way you handled the deploy rollback was zen :sparkles:
Raj: Meme posted: "Team: ship by EOD. Model: 'I present you with seasonal nonsense'" + tiny reindeer GIF :deer: :laughing:
Maria: Vote time — react with :snowflake: for your fav meme. Also drop any last kudos.
Devon: :snowflake: on @Raj (that reindeer gif sold it)
Sara: :snowflake: on @Devon (for on-call heroics)
Maria: :snowflake: on @Maria (self-nom? fine, but I'm biased) :grin:
OfficeBot: Reactions summary — :snowflake: x3 across thread.
Maria: OK this has been delightful. I'll grab the mystery snack pack and deliver to the winners (and maybe the rest of you, depends on budget) :package:
Raj: Thanks everyone — great way to end the week. Last kudos: shoutout to the ops crew for the infra tune-ups.
Maria: Last call for kudos — locking thread at 5pm PST. Happy holidays y'all :tada:
